caption: The green start button on a conveyor belt is pressed, and the belt begins to move.

sa.check: A conveyor belt with a green start button.
The belt is still before the press.
The order is still, press, moving.

pc.expect: The belt starts to move at the moment the button is pressed, and only then, and carries anything on it along.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and the belt stays still to the end of the clip; or the belt moves before the press; or the belt moves with the button untouched; or the belt moves while items on it stay in place.

pc.expect: Before the press nothing on the belt or its frame moves; afterwards the belt runs steadily in one direction and nothing else in the scene starts moving on its own.
pc.fail: The belt stops and restarts with nothing pressed; or reverses direction; or other machines in the scene start moving at the press; or items on the belt slide against the belt's direction.

pc.expect: The belt's surface moves as one continuous sheet over its rollers in one direction; items on it ride along at the belt's speed.
pc.fail: The belt surface moves in patches at different speeds; or an item on the belt races ahead of the belt or lags behind while resting on it; or the rollers turn while the belt stays still; or the belt surface moves sideways off its rollers.

pc.expect: The belt is a flexible band that bends round its rollers and lies flat between them; the frame stays rigid.
pc.fail: The belt stands rigid off its rollers; or ripples like water; or the frame bends as the belt starts; or the belt stretches visibly.

pc.expect: One belt on one frame; items on the belt keep their number and pass through nothing; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Items on the belt appear or vanish; or an item sinks into the belt; or the belt splits; or the finger passes into the control panel.

pc.expect: The belt's colour, the frame and the button's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The belt changes colour; or the frame changes; or the button changes colour or place.
